references.text: Your God the Lord will destroy the nations and give you their land, a theme repeated here in connection with cities of refuge.
Describes how the Lord will drive out the peoples before Israel, and Israel will take possession of their land.
The command to drive out the inhabitants of the land and settle in their land.
The fulfillment of the promise that the Lord will dispossess the nations and give Israel their land.
The promise of receiving cities and houses that Israel did not build, linked to taking possession of the land.
The Lord drives out nations greater and more powerful than Israel in order to give them the land.
Israel shall cross the Jordan and drive out nations greater than themselves with the Lord's help.
